review_scope: Fresh-context independent review of the current proof only, after AGENTS.md, README introduction, and PROJECT_STATE stage/objective/unattended_assurance. No previous review or proof version consulted.

comprehension.claim: A midpoint of a sufficiently narrow valid enclosure gives a uniform absolute-error guarantee; a qualified procedure producing and publishing that enclosure by a deadline gives separate availability and correct-and-available probability bounds under one scenario law.
comprehension.deterministic_range_check: For a finite ordered outer interval, midpoint error is at most half its width. For a nonempty bounded exact attainable range, endpoint-approaching sequences establish the minimax lower bound even for unattained endpoints. A broad outer interval cannot establish physical impossibility.
comprehension.probability_check: With P(E)>=1-alpha and P(A)>=1-beta under the same qualified law, A implies timely authorization and E intersect A implies correctness and timely authorization. The union bound gives max(0,1-alpha-beta) without independence. The separate availability bound is 1-beta. Conditional recovery laws require their own qualifications.
comprehension.deadline_check: Assumption 3 supplies mandatory publication, bounded scheduling and queue delay, a common time basis, T_build+L_pub<=T, and retained query validity through publication. Transport/revalidation belongs to event A and the timing bound, so narrow-enclosure construction alone is not treated as a full service deadline.
comprehension.counterexample_search: Checked narrow intervals with an arbitrary reported point outside their tolerance band; wide outer intervals enclosing a singleton exact range; nonattained exact-range endpoints; disjoint containment and build failure events; data-selected subgroups with concentrated errors; indefinite publication queues; stale transported enclosures; and permanent refusal. Each either obeys the stated bound or violates an explicitly required assumption. No counterexample within the stated assumptions was found.
comprehension.limitations: The result is a conditional composition theorem. It supplies no H7 enclosure construction, calibrated containment probability, arrival schedule, useful recovery stimulus, resource bound, lifetime outage bound, or numerical values for its requirements.

remaining_application_obligations: Specify the qualified scenario or conditional recovery law, query boundary/horizon, tolerance, deadlines, and risk budgets; establish all probability claims under that same law.
Construct and validate simultaneous query containment, including model and numerical error and validity after required state transport.
Prove narrow-enclosure production and completion of validity checks by T_build with probability at least 1-beta, using observable or conservatively validated information conditions.
Prove mandatory publication within L_pub, including scheduling, queues, transport/revalidation, and a common clock, with T_build+L_pub<=T.
For a reported point other than the enclosure midpoint, verify its own worst-endpoint tolerance predicate and include passing that predicate in the availability event.
Qualify arrival schedules, processing/backlog, achievable excitation, available power/load, and fault recovery conditions; separately derive any lifetime availability guarantee.
